items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Tubby Hall made a roll like Downs. Norman Downs that's dead. That's another one.

ctx.x: Can you tell us a little bit more about Tubby Hall? No.

Tubby Hall was a great rhythm drummer. Read music fair. Didn't really like Baby Dotts. I've got to give the old man credit. Baby Dotts can read music. Tubby Hall had a roll on a drum that's practically near as good as contral. And that's why Baby always wanted to make a roll like Tubby Hall. Tubby Hall made a roll like Downs. Norman Downs that's dead. That's another one. And I don't know where he got that roll from. Cause he learned in the contral. But I don't know where he stole it from contral or what. For…
